parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented police targeting of gender-nonconforming people, no recorded trans violence, and the sodomy/indecency provisions are documented as unenforced — a dead-letter statute that must not dominate (rule 2). The absent gender-recognition and anti-discrimination regimes are resident gaps, discounted unless shown to reach visitors (rule 1), and no dossier item shows border, facility, custody or ward practice — open questions, lighter than known exposures (rule 13). The genuine negatives reaching a traveller are documented LGBTIQ discrimination across public services and a reporting-chill that weakens recourse — but the evidence is LGBTIQ-wide rather than trans-specific or visitor-specific (rule 17), and the record shows no pervasive hostility beyond it. Thin data does not resolve to the midpoint, yet neither does it support the tier-3 anchors where trans-specific surveys documented widespread visitor-facing refusal. A step below acceptance-with-protections.
